add.bucketHint: If set, testing and exploration use this exact bucket instead of listing every bucket in the account — useful for a restricted IAM policy (s3:ListBucket on this bucket) instead of account-wide s3:ListAllMyBuckets. If this source is used as a medallion project's object store (or as a file-import archive), this is also the bucket bronze data lands in — set an already-existing bucket here if your credentials lack s3:CreateBucket.

imports.title: File imports
imports.subtitle: Import a CSV or Excel file as a real SQL table in the imports schema — the file never reaches Airflow.

wizard.title: Import a file
wizard.description: Drop a file, choose its format and targets, then analyze it.
wizard.dropFile: Drop a file or click to browse
wizard.modeTypedHelp: Decide columns and types now; a cell that can't convert becomes empty. Best for a clean, stable file.
wizard.modePayloadHelp: Capture the file faithfully first, structure it later; no row is ever lost, every rejection is traceable. Best for a messy or shifting file.
wizard.payloadOrientation: Structuring (types, columns) happens from the medallion canvas, on the bronze dataset — not here.
